rules: New stdlib functions are slash-namespaced: file/read, string/split, http/get, json/encode. Legacy Scheme names (string-append, string-length, substring) still work.
Predicates end in ?: null?, list?, file/exists?. Arrow conversions use ->: string->symbol, keyword->string.
Sema ships as a single binary. Run a file with `sema file.sema`, evaluate with `sema -e "(+ 1 2)"`, start the REPL with `sema`.
LLM calls are language primitives, not an SDK. Use llm/complete, llm/with-fallback, and the agent/tool forms directly.
Use ```sema for code blocks. Outside Sema-aware renderers, ```scheme is the closest fallback.
